title: Former footballer Gorkšs sent on to tackle Latvian civil service
summary_full: On Monday, November 16, Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs introduced the new head of the State Chancellery, and in effect the senior civil servant in the country, former football international Kaspars Gorkšs, to the State Chancellery team, wishing him success in his position.
